responsibility: Lowers Rust function ABI boundaries to Cranelift by turning rustc `FnAbi`/calling conventions into Cranelift signatures and call sites, applying special-case convention adjustments for imported, libcall, variadic, and drop callees, converting `PassMode` argument and return descriptions into concrete Cranelift parameters and values, setting up and decoding incoming parameters and return destinations inside functions, collecting and emitting call and function returns, and optionally annotating the generated IR with comments that explain the resulting ABI and local-storage mapping decisions.
